name: Mimasaka Kanata
source:
The teacher of the calligraphy class that Keisuke attended.

He still has Keisuke's name in the classroom, so he feels lonely that he doesn't show up often after starting college.

[Translated from [url=https://skt-pnt.netlify.app/myteacher]official website[/url]]
